verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair trust-control question for a consumer AI assistant that holds chat history and account data, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only related controls: revoking access (instinct-docs-6), opting out of training (instinct-docs-12), and deleting indexed external data (instinct-docs-14, instinct-comm-3).
